400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil
554: }

558: 	req.Sprint = strings.TrimSpace(req.Sprint)

563: 	req.Level = strings.TrimSpace(req.Level)

565: 	req.Test = strings.TrimSpace(req.Test)

574: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
575: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
576: 		if value == "" {
577: 			continue
578: 		}
579: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
580: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
581: 		}
582: 		for _, r := range value {
583: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
584: 				continue
585: 			}
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	return nil
590: }

592: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
593: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
594: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
595: 	for _, value := range values {
596: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
597: 		if value == "" {
598: 			continue
599: 		}
600: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
601: 			continue
602: 		}
603: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
604: 		out = append(out, value)
605: 	}
606: 	sort.Strings(out)
607: 	return out
608: }

636: func operationRuntimeIdentity(req OperationRequest, stages map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime) string {
637: 	if req.Model != "" {
638: 		return "requested model " + req.Model
639: 	}
640: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
641: 	switch req.Kind {
642: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
643: 		stage = sprint.StageExecute
644: 	case OperationReviewStart:
645: 		stage = sprint.StageReview
646: 	case OperationSmokeStart, OperationVerifyStart:
647: 		stage = sprint.StageSmoke
648: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
649: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
650: 			return "configured smoke author and harness"
651: 		}
652: 		return "configured QA runtime"
653: 	}
654: 	if runtime, ok := stages[stage]; ok && (runtime.Model != "" || runtime.Variant != "") {
655: 		return strings.TrimSpace(runtime.Model + " variant=" + runtime.Variant)
656: 	}
657: 	if req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart {
658: 		return "configured smoke author and harness"
659: 	}
660: 	return "effective workspace runtime configuration"
661: }

150: func (h *operationHub) startConfirmed(session, dedupKey string, confirm func() (app.Confirmation, error)) (operationDocument, error) {
151: 	h.mu.Lock()
152: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
153: 	h.reapLocked()
154: 	if id := h.dedup[dedupKey]; dedupKey != "" && id != "" {
155: 		if record := h.records[id]; record != nil && record.session == session {
156: 			return cloneOperationDocument(record.doc), nil
157: 		}
158: 		delete(h.dedup, dedupKey)
159: 	}
160: 	if h.draining {
161: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
162: 		return operationDocument{}, errServerDraining
163: 	}
164: 	if h.active >= MaxActiveOperations {
165: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
166: 		return operationDocument{}, errOperationCapacity
167: 	}
168: 	if h.ops == nil {
169: 		return operationDocument{}, errors.New("operation capability unavailable")
170: 	}
171: 	prepared, err := confirm()
172: 	if err != nil {
173: 		return operationDocument{}, err
174: 	}
175: 	id := "op_" + h.id()
176: 	for h.records[id] != nil {
177: 		id = "op_" + h.id()
178: 	}
179: 	created := h.now().UTC()
180: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(h.rootCtx)
181: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
182: 		accepted, acceptErr := manager.AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)
183: 		if acceptErr != nil {
184: 			if !errors.Is(acceptErr, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
185: 				cancel()
186: 				return operationDocument{}, acceptErr
187: 			}
188: 		} else {
189: 			id = accepted.RunID
190: 			if accepted.Context != nil {
191: 				ctx = accepted.Context
192: 			}
193: 			if accepted.Existing {
194: 				doc := operationDocument{ID: id, Kind: prepared.Request.Kind, State: accepted.Lifecycle, CreatedAt: created, DurableStatus: durableStatusDTO{Available: true, RefreshPath: "/runs/" + id}}
195: 				cancel()
196: 				return doc, nil
197: 			}
198: 		}
199: 	}
200: 	record := &operationRecord{
201: 		doc: operationDocument{
202: 			ID: id, Kind: prepared.Request.Kind, State: "accepted", CreatedAt: created,
203: 			DurableStatus: durableStatusDTO{Available: prepared.DurableRefreshPath != "", RefreshPath: prepared.DurableRefreshPath},
204: 		},
205: 		session: session, request: prepared.Request, cancel: cancel, done: make(chan struct{}),
206: 		subscribers: make(map[uint64]*operationSubscriber), dedupKey: dedupKey,
207: 	}
208: 	h.records[id] = record
209: 	if dedupKey != "" {
210: 		h.dedup[dedupKey] = id
211: 	}
212: 	h.active++
213: 	h.counters.starts.Add(1)
214: 	h.counters.active.Add(1)
215: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": "accepted"})
216: 	doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
217: 	go h.run(ctx, record)
218: 	return doc, nil
219: }

221: func (h *operationHub) run(ctx context.Context, record *operationRecord) {
222: 	started := h.now().UTC()
223: 	h.mu.Lock()
224: 	if record.doc.State == "accepted" {
225: 		record.doc.State = "running"
226: 		record.doc.StartedAt = &started
227: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "progress", map[string]any{"message": "operation started", "state": "running"})
228: 	}
229: 	h.mu.Unlock()
230: 
231: 	result, runErr := h.ops.RunOperation(ctx, record.request, func(event app.OperationEvent) {
232: 		h.publishAppEvent(record, event)
233: 	})
234: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
235: 		finishCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
236: 		finishErr := manager.FinishOperation(finishCtx, record.doc.ID, result.State, runErr)
237: 		cancel()
238: 		if finishErr != nil && !errors.Is(finishErr, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
239: 			runErr = errors.Join(runErr, finishErr)
240: 		}
241: 	}
242: 	h.finish(record, result, runErr)
243: }

245: func (h *operationHub) publishAppEvent(record *operationRecord, event app.OperationEvent) {
246: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
247: 		committed, err := manager.RecordOperationEvent(context.Background(), record.doc.ID, event)
248: 		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
249: 			record.cancel()
250: 			return
251: 		}
252: 		if err == nil && !committed {
253: 			return
254: 		}
255: 	}
256: 	name := "progress"
257: 	if event.State == app.OperationFailed {
258: 		name = "warning"
259: 	}
260: 	payload := map[string]any{
261: 		"state": string(event.State), "stage": safeWebText(event.Stage), "task": safeWebText(event.Task),
262: 		"message": safeWebText(event.Message), "completed": event.Completed, "total": event.Total, "attempt": event.Attempt,
263: 		"event_kind": safeWebText(event.EventKind), "event_type": safeWebText(event.EventType), "tool": safeWebText(event.Tool), "action": safeWebText(event.Action),
264: 		"tool_call_id": safeWebText(event.ToolCallID), "tool_status": safeWebText(event.ToolStatus),
265: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
266: 		"reason": safeWebText(event.Reason), "detail": safeWebText(event.Detail),
267: 		"runtime_attempts": event.RuntimeAttempts, "turns": event.Turns, "turns_known": event.TurnsKnown,
268: 		"tokens": event.Tokens, "tokens_known": event.TokensKnown, "duration": safeWebText(event.Duration),
269: 		"provider": safeWebText(event.Provider), "model": safeWebText(event.Model), "harness": safeWebText(event.Harness), "cost": safeWebText(event.Cost), "runtime_events": event.RuntimeEvents,
270: 	}
271: 	h.mu.Lock()
272: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
273: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
274: 		return
275: 	}
276: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, name, payload)
277: }

279: func (h *operationHub) finish(record *operationRecord, result app.OperationResult, runErr error) {
280: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
281: 	h.mu.Lock()
282: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
283: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
284: 		return
285: 	}
286: 	state := "succeeded"
287: 	switch {
288: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), result.State == app.OperationCancelled:
289: 		state = "cancelled"
290: 	case runErr != nil, result.State == app.OperationFailed:
291: 		state = "failed"
292: 	case result.State == app.OperationPartial:
293: 		state = "interrupted"
294: 	}
295: 	record.doc.State = state
296: 	record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
297: 	record.doc.Result = projectOperationResult(result)
298: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": state, "reason": record.doc.Reason, "result": record.doc.Result})
299: 	h.active--
300: 	h.counters.active.Add(-1)
301: 	h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
302: 	close(record.done)
303: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
304: 		close(subscriber.ch)
305: 		delete(record.subscribers, id)
306: 		h.streams--
307: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
308: 	}
309: }

324: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()

326: 	result := make([]activeOperationDTO, 0, h.active)

347: func (h *operationHub) cancelOperation(session, id, reason string) (operationDocument, bool, error) {
348: 	h.mu.Lock()
349: 	record := h.records[id]
350: 	if record == nil || (session != "" && record.session != session) {
351: 		h.mu.Unlock()
352: 		return operationDocument{}, false, errOperationNotFound
353: 	}
354: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
355: 		doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
356: 		h.mu.Unlock()

358: 	}
359: 	requested := false
360: 	record.cancelOnce.Do(func() {
361: 		requested = true

363: 		record.doc.Reason = canonicalCancelReason(reason)
364: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "cancel_requested", map[string]any{"reason": record.doc.Reason})
365: 	})

368: 	h.mu.Unlock()

371: 		cancel()
372: 	}

376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {
377: 	h.mu.Lock()
378: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
379: 	h.reapLocked()
380: 	record := h.records[id]
381: 	if record == nil || record.session != session {
382: 		return nil, nil, nil, errOperationNotFound
383: 	}
384: 	if h.streams >= MaxConcurrentStreams || len(record.subscribers) >= MaxSubscribersPerOperation {
385: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
386: 		return nil, nil, nil, errSubscriberCapacity
387: 	}
388: 	if lastID > 0 && len(record.events) > 0 && lastID < record.events[0].ID-1 {
389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),
392: 			"newest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.nextEventID, 10),
393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,
394: 		})
395: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
396: 	}
397: 	replay := make([]operationEvent, 0, len(record.events))
398: 	for _, event := range record.events {
399: 		if event.ID > lastID {
400: 			replay = append(replay, event)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	record.nextSubID++
404: 	sub := &operationSubscriber{id: record.nextSubID, ch: make(chan operationEvent, SubscriberQueueSize)}
405: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
406: 		close(sub.ch)
407: 	} else {
408: 		record.subscribers[sub.id] = sub
409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}
412: 	var once sync.Once
413: 	unsubscribe := func() {
414: 		once.Do(func() {
415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})
424: 	}
425: 	return replay, sub.ch, unsubscribe, nil
426: }

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {
429: 	name = stableOperationEventName(name)
430: 	record.nextEventID++
431: 	body := map[string]any{
432: 		"operation_id": record.doc.ID,
433: 		"time":         h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
434: 		"sequence":     record.nextEventID,
435: 		"payload":      payload,
436: 	}
437: 	data, err := json.Marshal(body)
438: 	if err != nil {
439: 		h.counters.projectionDrops.Add(1)
440: 		return
441: 	}
442: 	if len(data) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {
443: 		data, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]any{
444: 			"operation_id": record.doc.ID, "time": h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},
446: 		})
447: 		name = "warning"
448: 	}
449: 	event := operationEvent{ID: record.nextEventID, Name: name, Data: data}
450: 	record.events = append(record.events, event)
451: 	record.eventBytes += len(data)
452: 	for len(record.events) > MaxEventsPerOperation || record.eventBytes > MaxEventBytesPerOperation {
453: 		record.eventBytes -= len(record.events[0].Data)
454: 		record.events = record.events[1:]
455: 	}
456: 	record.doc.LastEventID = strconv.FormatUint(event.ID, 10)
457: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
458: 		select {
459: 		case subscriber.ch <- event:
460: 		default:
461: 			close(subscriber.ch)
462: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
463: 			h.streams--
464: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
465: 			h.counters.slowSubscribers.Add(1)
466: 		}
467: 	}
468: }

470: func stableOperationEventName(name string) string {
471: 	switch name {
472: 	case "snapshot", "progress", "warning", "finding", "artifact", "cancel_requested", "recovery_required", "terminal":
473: 		return name
474: 	default:
475: 		return "progress"

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)
500: 		}
501: 	}
502: 	return nil
503: }

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {
506: 	recorder, ok := h.ops.(app.OperationCleanupRecorder)
507: 	if !ok {
508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})
525: 		cancel()
526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return result
531: }

533: func (h *operationHub) markCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) {

535: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
536: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
537: 	for _, record := range records {
538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}

547: 		h.counters.active.Add(-1)
548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)

550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
553: 			h.streams--
554: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
555: 		}
556: 	}

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),
580: 		Content: safeProjectedText(result.Content, MaxTerminalResultBytes/2), Truncated: result.Truncated,
581: 	}
582: 	for _, finding := range result.Findings {
583: 		out.Findings = append(out.Findings, findingDTO{
584: 			Severity: safeWebText(finding.Severity), Section: safeWebText(finding.Section), Problem: safeWebText(finding.Problem),
585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})
587: 	}
588: 	if result.Error != nil {
589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),
591: 		}}
592: 	}

595: 		out.Findings = nil
596: 		out.Truncated = true
597: 		out.Message = safeBoundedText(out.Message, 4096)

133: func newOperationHub(rootCtx context.Context, ops app.WebOperations, now func() time.Time, id func() string) *operationHub {

146: func (h *operationHub) start(session string, prepared app.Confirmation) (operationDocument, error) {
147: 	return h.startConfirmed(session, "", func() (app.Confirmation, error) { return prepared, nil })

150: func (h *operationHub) startConfirmed(session, dedupKey string, confirm func() (app.Confirmation, error)) (operationDocument, error) {
151: 	h.mu.Lock()
152: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
153: 	h.reapLocked()
154: 	if id := h.dedup[dedupKey]; dedupKey != "" && id != "" {
155: 		if record := h.records[id]; record != nil && record.session == session {
156: 			return cloneOperationDocument(record.doc), nil
157: 		}
158: 		delete(h.dedup, dedupKey)
159: 	}
160: 	if h.draining {
161: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
162: 		return operationDocument{}, errServerDraining
163: 	}
164: 	if h.active >= MaxActiveOperations {
165: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
166: 		return operationDocument{}, errOperationCapacity
167: 	}
168: 	if h.ops == nil {
169: 		return operationDocument{}, errors.New("operation capability unavailable")
170: 	}
171: 	prepared, err := confirm()
172: 	if err != nil {
173: 		return operationDocument{}, err
174: 	}
175: 	id := "op_" + h.id()
176: 	for h.records[id] != nil {
177: 		id = "op_" + h.id()
178: 	}
179: 	created := h.now().UTC()
180: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(h.rootCtx)
181: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
182: 		accepted, acceptErr := manager.AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)
183: 		if acceptErr != nil {
184: 			if !errors.Is(acceptErr, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
185: 				cancel()
186: 				return operationDocument{}, acceptErr
187: 			}
188: 		} else {
189: 			id = accepted.RunID
190: 			if accepted.Context != nil {
191: 				ctx = accepted.Context
192: 			}
193: 			if accepted.Existing {
194: 				doc := operationDocument{ID: id, Kind: prepared.Request.Kind, State: accepted.Lifecycle, CreatedAt: created, DurableStatus: durableStatusDTO{Available: true, RefreshPath: "/runs/" + id}}
195: 				cancel()
196: 				return doc, nil
197: 			}
198: 		}
199: 	}
200: 	record := &operationRecord{
201: 		doc: operationDocument{
202: 			ID: id, Kind: prepared.Request.Kind, State: "accepted", CreatedAt: created,
203: 			DurableStatus: durableStatusDTO{Available: prepared.DurableRefreshPath != "", RefreshPath: prepared.DurableRefreshPath},
204: 		},
205: 		session: session, request: prepared.Request, cancel: cancel, done: make(chan struct{}),
206: 		subscribers: make(map[uint64]*operationSubscriber), dedupKey: dedupKey,
207: 	}
208: 	h.records[id] = record
209: 	if dedupKey != "" {
210: 		h.dedup[dedupKey] = id
211: 	}
212: 	h.active++
213: 	h.counters.starts.Add(1)
214: 	h.counters.active.Add(1)
215: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": "accepted"})
216: 	doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
217: 	go h.run(ctx, record)
218: 	return doc, nil
219: }

221: func (h *operationHub) run(ctx context.Context, record *operationRecord) {
222: 	started := h.now().UTC()
223: 	h.mu.Lock()
224: 	if record.doc.State == "accepted" {
225: 		record.doc.State = "running"
226: 		record.doc.StartedAt = &started
227: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "progress", map[string]any{"message": "operation started", "state": "running"})
228: 	}
229: 	h.mu.Unlock()
230: 
231: 	result, runErr := h.ops.RunOperation(ctx, record.request, func(event app.OperationEvent) {
232: 		h.publishAppEvent(record, event)
233: 	})
234: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
235: 		finishCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
236: 		finishErr := manager.FinishOperation(finishCtx, record.doc.ID, result.State, runErr)
237: 		cancel()
238: 		if finishErr != nil && !errors.Is(finishErr, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
239: 			runErr = errors.Join(runErr, finishErr)
240: 		}
241: 	}
242: 	h.finish(record, result, runErr)
243: }

245: func (h *operationHub) publishAppEvent(record *operationRecord, event app.OperationEvent) {
246: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
247: 		committed, err := manager.RecordOperationEvent(context.Background(), record.doc.ID, event)
248: 		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
249: 			record.cancel()
250: 			return
251: 		}
252: 		if err == nil && !committed {
253: 			return
254: 		}
255: 	}
256: 	name := "progress"
257: 	if event.State == app.OperationFailed {
258: 		name = "warning"
259: 	}
260: 	payload := map[string]any{
261: 		"state": string(event.State), "stage": safeWebText(event.Stage), "task": safeWebText(event.Task),
262: 		"message": safeWebText(event.Message), "completed": event.Completed, "total": event.Total, "attempt": event.Attempt,
263: 		"event_kind": safeWebText(event.EventKind), "event_type": safeWebText(event.EventType), "tool": safeWebText(event.Tool), "action": safeWebText(event.Action),
264: 		"tool_call_id": safeWebText(event.ToolCallID), "tool_status": safeWebText(event.ToolStatus),
265: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
266: 		"reason": safeWebText(event.Reason), "detail": safeWebText(event.Detail),
267: 		"runtime_attempts": event.RuntimeAttempts, "turns": event.Turns, "turns_known": event.TurnsKnown,
268: 		"tokens": event.Tokens, "tokens_known": event.TokensKnown, "duration": safeWebText(event.Duration),
269: 		"provider": safeWebText(event.Provider), "model": safeWebText(event.Model), "harness": safeWebText(event.Harness), "cost": safeWebText(event.Cost), "runtime_events": event.RuntimeEvents,
270: 	}
271: 	h.mu.Lock()
272: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
273: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
274: 		return
275: 	}
276: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, name, payload)
277: }

279: func (h *operationHub) finish(record *operationRecord, result app.OperationResult, runErr error) {
280: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
281: 	h.mu.Lock()
282: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
283: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
284: 		return
285: 	}
286: 	state := "succeeded"
287: 	switch {
288: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), result.State == app.OperationCancelled:
289: 		state = "cancelled"
290: 	case runErr != nil, result.State == app.OperationFailed:
291: 		state = "failed"
292: 	case result.State == app.OperationPartial:
293: 		state = "interrupted"
294: 	}
295: 	record.doc.State = state
296: 	record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
297: 	record.doc.Result = projectOperationResult(result)
298: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": state, "reason": record.doc.Reason, "result": record.doc.Result})
299: 	h.active--
300: 	h.counters.active.Add(-1)
301: 	h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
302: 	close(record.done)
303: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
304: 		close(subscriber.ch)
305: 		delete(record.subscribers, id)
306: 		h.streams--
307: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
308: 	}
309: }

311: func (h *operationHub) status(session, id string) (operationDocument, error) {
312: 	h.mu.Lock()
313: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
314: 	h.reapLocked()
315: 	record := h.records[id]
316: 	if record == nil || record.session != session {
317: 		return operationDocument{}, errOperationNotFound
318: 	}
319: 	return cloneOperationDocument(record.doc), nil
320: }

322: func (h *operationHub) activeOperations(session string) []activeOperationDTO {
323: 	h.mu.Lock()
324: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
325: 	h.reapLocked()
326: 	result := make([]activeOperationDTO, 0, h.active)
327: 	for _, record := range h.records {
328: 		if record.session != session || terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
329: 			continue
330: 		}
331: 		result = append(result, activeOperationDTO{
332: 			ID: record.doc.ID, Kind: record.doc.Kind, State: record.doc.State,
333: 			Project: record.request.Project, Sprint: record.request.Sprint, Study: record.request.Study,
334: 			StartedAt: record.doc.StartedAt,
335: 		})
336: 	}
337: 	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
338: 		left, right := result[i].StartedAt, result[j].StartedAt
339: 		if left == nil || right == nil {
340: 			return left != nil
341: 		}
342: 		return left.After(*right)
343: 	})
344: 	return result
345: }

347: func (h *operationHub) cancelOperation(session, id, reason string) (operationDocument, bool, error) {
348: 	h.mu.Lock()
349: 	record := h.records[id]
350: 	if record == nil || (session != "" && record.session != session) {
351: 		h.mu.Unlock()
352: 		return operationDocument{}, false, errOperationNotFound
353: 	}
354: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
355: 		doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
356: 		h.mu.Unlock()
357: 		return doc, false, nil
358: 	}
359: 	requested := false
360: 	record.cancelOnce.Do(func() {
361: 		requested = true
362: 		record.doc.State = "cancelling"
363: 		record.doc.Reason = canonicalCancelReason(reason)
364: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "cancel_requested", map[string]any{"reason": record.doc.Reason})
365: 	})
366: 	doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
367: 	cancel := record.cancel
368: 	h.mu.Unlock()
369: 	if requested {
370: 		h.counters.cancellations.Add(1)
371: 		cancel()
372: 	}
373: 	return doc, requested, nil
374: }

376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {
377: 	h.mu.Lock()
378: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
379: 	h.reapLocked()
380: 	record := h.records[id]
381: 	if record == nil || record.session != session {
382: 		return nil, nil, nil, errOperationNotFound
383: 	}
384: 	if h.streams >= MaxConcurrentStreams || len(record.subscribers) >= MaxSubscribersPerOperation {
385: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
386: 		return nil, nil, nil, errSubscriberCapacity
387: 	}
388: 	if lastID > 0 && len(record.events) > 0 && lastID < record.events[0].ID-1 {
389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),
392: 			"newest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.nextEventID, 10),
393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,
394: 		})
395: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
396: 	}
397: 	replay := make([]operationEvent, 0, len(record.events))
398: 	for _, event := range record.events {
399: 		if event.ID > lastID {
400: 			replay = append(replay, event)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	record.nextSubID++
404: 	sub := &operationSubscriber{id: record.nextSubID, ch: make(chan operationEvent, SubscriberQueueSize)}
405: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
406: 		close(sub.ch)
407: 	} else {
408: 		record.subscribers[sub.id] = sub
409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}
412: 	var once sync.Once
413: 	unsubscribe := func() {
414: 		once.Do(func() {
415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})
424: 	}
425: 	return replay, sub.ch, unsubscribe, nil
426: }

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {
429: 	name = stableOperationEventName(name)
430: 	record.nextEventID++
431: 	body := map[string]any{
432: 		"operation_id": record.doc.ID,
433: 		"time":         h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
434: 		"sequence":     record.nextEventID,
435: 		"payload":      payload,
436: 	}
437: 	data, err := json.Marshal(body)
438: 	if err != nil {
439: 		h.counters.projectionDrops.Add(1)
440: 		return
441: 	}
442: 	if len(data) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {
443: 		data, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]any{
444: 			"operation_id": record.doc.ID, "time": h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},
446: 		})
447: 		name = "warning"
448: 	}
449: 	event := operationEvent{ID: record.nextEventID, Name: name, Data: data}
450: 	record.events = append(record.events, event)
451: 	record.eventBytes += len(data)
452: 	for len(record.events) > MaxEventsPerOperation || record.eventBytes > MaxEventBytesPerOperation {
453: 		record.eventBytes -= len(record.events[0].Data)
454: 		record.events = record.events[1:]
455: 	}
456: 	record.doc.LastEventID = strconv.FormatUint(event.ID, 10)
457: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
458: 		select {
459: 		case subscriber.ch <- event:
460: 		default:
461: 			close(subscriber.ch)
462: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
463: 			h.streams--
464: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
465: 			h.counters.slowSubscribers.Add(1)
466: 		}
467: 	}
468: }
469: 
470: func stableOperationEventName(name string) string {
471: 	switch name {
472: 	case "snapshot", "progress", "warning", "finding", "artifact", "cancel_requested", "recovery_required", "terminal":
473: 		return name
474: 	default:
475: 		return "progress"
476: 	}
477: }

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)
500: 		}
501: 	}
502: 	return nil
503: }
504: 
505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {
506: 	recorder, ok := h.ops.(app.OperationCleanupRecorder)
507: 	if !ok {
508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})
525: 		cancel()
526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return result
531: }
532: 
533: func (h *operationHub) markCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) {
534: 	h.mu.Lock()
535: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
536: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
537: 	for _, record := range records {
538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}
545: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
546: 		h.active--
547: 		h.counters.active.Add(-1)
548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
549: 		close(record.done)
550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
553: 			h.streams--
554: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
555: 		}
556: 	}
557: }
558: 
559: func (h *operationHub) isDraining() bool {
560: 	h.mu.Lock()
561: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
562: 	return h.draining
563: }
564: 
565: func (h *operationHub) reapLocked() {
566: 	now := h.now().UTC()
567: 	for id, record := range h.records {
568: 		if record.doc.FinishedAt != nil && now.Sub(*record.doc.FinishedAt) >= TerminalRetention {
569: 			delete(h.records, id)
570: 			if record.dedupKey != "" {

78: func (h *handler) handleOperationPrepare(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
79: 	if h.hub == nil || h.hub.ops == nil {
80: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("operation capability unavailable"))
81: 		return
82: 	}
83: 	if h.hub.isDraining() {
84: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errServerDraining)
85: 		return
86: 	}
87: 	var payload prepareRequest
88: 	if err := decodeStrictJSON(r, &payload); err != nil {
89: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
90: 		return
91: 	}
92: 	req, err := mapOperationRequest(payload.Operation)
93: 	if err != nil {
94: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
95: 		return
96: 	}
97: 	confirmation, err := h.hub.ops.PrepareOperation(r.Context(), req)
98: 	if err != nil {
99: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
100: 		return
101: 	}
102: 	record, err := h.preparations.issue(sessionID(r.Context()), confirmation)
103: 	if err != nil {
104: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
105: 		return
106: 	}
107: 	h.logOperation(r, "operation_prepared", "", string(confirmation.Request.Kind), "prepared", "")
108: 	dto := preparationDTO{
109: 		PreparationID: record.ID, Operation: mapOperationSpec(confirmation.Request), AffectedPaths: append([]string(nil), confirmation.Paths...),
110: 		MutationClass: confirmation.MutationClass, Prerequisites: append([]string(nil), confirmation.Prerequisites...),
111: 		InputFingerprint: confirmation.InputFingerprint, ExpiresAt: record.ExpiresAt, ConfirmationToken: record.Token,
112: 	}
113: 	if confirmation.Runtime {
114: 		dto.Runtime = runtimeConfirmationDTO(confirmation)
115: 	}
116: 	if confirmation.Request.Kind == app.OperationSmokeStart || confirmation.Request.Kind == app.OperationSmokeDryRun {
117: 		dto.Harness = map[string]any{"kind": "configured_smoke_harness"}
118: 	}
119: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, dto, nil)
120: }

185: func (h *handler) handleActiveOperations(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
186: 	operations := h.hub.activeOperations(sessionID(r.Context()))
187: 	if h.runs != nil {
188: 		page, err := h.runs.Runs(r.Context(), app.RunQuery{Lifecycle: []app.RunLifecycle{"accepted", "queued", "running", "cancelling"}, TargetKind: "operation", Limit: 200})
189: 		if err == nil {
190: 			seen := make(map[string]bool, len(operations))
191: 			for _, operation := range operations {
192: 				seen[operation.ID] = true
193: 			}
194: 			for _, snapshot := range page.Runs {
195: 				if seen[string(snapshot.RunID)] || !snapshot.Lifecycle.IsActive() || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
196: 					continue
197: 				}
198: 				operations = append(operations, durableActiveOperation(snapshot))
199: 			}
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: 	count := len(operations)
203: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, operations, &app.CollectionInfo{ReturnedCount: count, TotalCount: count})
204: }

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

536: func operationSpecFromForm(r *http.Request) operationSpecRequest {
537: 	parallelism, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.FormValue("parallelism"))
538: 	sprintRef := r.FormValue("sprint")
539: 	if sprintRef == "" {
540: 		sprintRef = newSprintRef(r.FormValue("sprint_number"), r.FormValue("sprint_name"))
541: 	}

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

556: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
557: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
558: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
559: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
560: 		return ""
561: 	}
562: 	for _, r := range number {
563: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
564: 			return number + "-" + name
565: 		}
566: 	}
567: 	var slug strings.Builder
568: 	separator := false
569: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
570: 		switch {
571: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
572: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
573: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
574: 			}
575: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
576: 			separator = false
577: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
578: 			separator = true
579: 		default:
580: 			return number + "-" + name
581: 		}
582: 	}
583: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
584: 		return ""
585: 	}
586: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
587: }

594: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
595: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
596: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
597: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
598: 	}
599: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
600: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
601: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
602: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
603: 	}
604: 	var extra any
605: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
606: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
607: 	}
608: 	return nil
609: }

611: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
612: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
613: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
614: 	}
615: 	options := spec.Options
616: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
617: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
618: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,
619: 		Level: options.Level, Suite: options.Suite, Test: options.Test, Timeout: options.Timeout,
620: 		ForceReview: options.ForceReview, RestartReview: options.RestartReview, OverrideRationale: options.OverrideRationale,
621: 		ReviewFocus: options.ReviewFocus, Sources: options.Sources, Dimensions: options.Dimensions, Parallelism: options.Parallelism,
622: 	}
623: 	kind := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Kind), "_", "-")
624: 	switch kind {
625: 	case "validation", "validate":
626: 		req.Kind = app.OperationValidate
627: 	case "sprint-status":
628: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSprintStatus
629: 	case "prompt-preview", "sprint-prompt":
630: 		req.Kind = app.OperationPrompt
631: 	case "dry-run", "sprint-flow-dry-run":

802: func (h *handler) writeOperationError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
803: 	status, code, message, retryable := http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The operation request is invalid.", false
804: 	details := map[string]any{}
805: 	switch {
806: 	case errors.Is(err, errConfirmationExpired):
807: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusConflict, "confirmation_expired", "The confirmation expired. Prepare the operation again.", true
808: 	case errors.Is(err, errConfirmationMismatch):
809: 		status, code, message = http.StatusConflict, "confirmation_mismatch", "The confirmation does not match this session or operation."
810: 	case errors.Is(err, errConfirmationReplayed):
811: 		status, code, message = http.StatusConflict, "confirmation_replayed", "The confirmation was already used or is unknown."
812: 	case errors.Is(err, errStaleConfirmation), errors.Is(err, app.ErrStaleOperation):
813: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusConflict, "stale_confirmation", "The operation inputs changed after confirmation. Prepare it again.", true
814: 	case errors.Is(err, errOperationNotFound):
815: 		status, code, message = http.StatusNotFound, "operation_not_found", "The operation is no longer retained. Refresh durable status."
816: 		details["action"] = "refresh_durable_status"
817: 	case errors.Is(err, errOperationCapacity):
818: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusTooManyRequests, "operation_capacity", "Operation capacity is currently full.", true
819: 		w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
820: 	case errors.Is(err, errSubscriberCapacity):
821: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusTooManyRequests, "subscriber_capacity", "Stream capacity is currently full.", true
822: 		w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
823: 	case errors.Is(err, errServerDraining):
824: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_draining", "The server is shutting down and is not accepting new work.", true
825: 		w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
826: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
827: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_draining", "The server is shutting down.", true
828: 	case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "validation"), strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "incomplete"), strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "prerequisite"):
829: 		status, code, message = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "validation_failed", "The governed inputs failed validation."
830: 	case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "lock"), strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "in progress"):
831: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusConflict, "operation_conflict", "A conflicting operation is already running.", true
832: 	case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "unavailable"):
833: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusFailedDependency, "prerequisite_unavailable", "A required operation prerequisite is unavailable.", true
834: 	case !isClientOperationError(err):
835: 		status, code, message = http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_failure", "The operation could not be completed."
836: 	}
837: 	if cause := safeOperationCause(err); cause != "" && status < http.StatusInternalServerError {
838: 		details["reason"] = cause
839: 		details["guidance"] = operationFailureGuidance(code)
840: 	}
841: 	h.writeErrorDetails(w, r, status, errorBody{Code: code, Message: message, Retryable: retryable, Details: details})
842: }

844: func safeOperationCause(err error) string {
845: 	if err == nil {
846: 		return ""
847: 	}
848: 	text := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
849: 	if isClientOperationError(err) || strings.Contains(text, "validation") || strings.Contains(text, "incomplete") || strings.Contains(text, "prerequisite") || strings.Contains(text, "lock") || strings.Contains(text, "in progress") || strings.Contains(text, "unavailable") {
850: 		return safeWebText(err.Error())
851: 	}
852: 	return ""
853: }

855: func operationFailureGuidance(code string) string {
856: 	switch code {

859: 	case "operation_conflict":

Its controlOperation loop will see CancellationRequested → ack → cancel ctx → operation unwinds → FinishOperation → terminal cancelled. Good.

BUT what if the TUI operation is running WITHOUT a durable manager or ActiveRunID == "" (e.g., runtime-free in-process ops like validate/sprint-status — wait those don't set Running? 164: func (m Model) Update(msg Message) Model {
165: 	switch v := msg.(type) {
166: 	case LoadMsg:
167: 		m.Loading = false
168: 		if v.Err != nil {
169: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
170: 			return m
171: 		}
172: 		m.Data = v.Result
173: 		m.Runs = v.Runs
174: 		m.DurableEvents = dedupeDurableEvents(v.Events)
175: 		m.Error = ""
176: 		m.clampSelection()
177: 	case RefreshMsg:
178: 		m.Loading = false
179: 		m.Preview = nil
180: 		m.PreviewOffset = 0
181: 		if v.Err != nil {
182: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
183: 			return m
184: 		}
185: 		m.Data = v.Result
186: 		m.Runs = v.Runs
187: 		m.DurableEvents = dedupeDurableEvents(v.Events)
188: 		m.Error = ""
189: 		m.clampSelection()
190: 	case PreviewMsg:
191: 		if v.Route != (Route{}) && v.Route != m.currentRoute() {
192: 			return m
193: 		}
194: 		if v.Err != nil {
195: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
196: 			return m
197: 		}
198: 		m.Preview = &v.Result
199: 		m.PreviewTitle = v.Title
200: 		m.Error = ""
201: 		m.PreviewOffset = 0
202: 	case ValidationMsg:
203: 		m.Loading = false
204: 		if v.Route != m.currentRoute() {
205: 			return m
206: 		}
207: 		if v.Err != nil {
208: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
209: 			return m
210: 		}
211: 		m.Validation = &v.Result
212: 		m.Error = ""
213: 	case ConfirmationMsg:
214: 		m.Loading = false
215: 		if v.Route != m.currentRoute() {
216: 			return m
217: 		}
218: 		if v.Err != nil {
219: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
220: 			return m
221: 		}
222: 		m.Confirmation = &v.Result
223: 	case OperationEventMsg:
224: 		if !m.Running {
225: 			return m
226: 		}
227: 		m.Events = append(m.Events, v.Event)
228: 		if len(m.Events) > 100 {
229: 			m.Events = m.Events[len(m.Events)-100:]
230: 		}
231: 	case OperationMsg:
232: 		m.Running = false
233: 		m.Loading = false
234: 		m.Confirmation = nil
235: 		m.Operation = &v.Result
236: 		m.Events = append(m.Events, v.Events...)
237: 		if len(m.Events) > 100 {
238: 			m.Events = m.Events[len(m.Events)-100:]
239: 		}
240: 		if v.Err != nil {
241: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
242: 		}
243: 	case KeyMsg:
244: 		switch KeyToAction(string(v)) {
245: 		case ActionQuit:
246: 			m.Quit = true
247: 		case ActionFocusNext:
248: 			if m.ActiveTab == TabProjects {
249: 				m.setTab(TabStudies)
250: 			} else {
251: 				m.setTab(TabProjects)
252: 			}
253: 		case ActionBack:
254: 			if m.Running && !m.OperationHidden {
255: 				return m
256: 			} else if m.ParallelForm != nil {
257: 				m.ParallelForm = nil
258: 				m.ParallelValue = ""
259: 				m.ParallelError = ""
260: 			} else if m.RunViewStudy != "" {
261: 				m.RunViewStudy = ""
262: 				m.RunViewShowPrevious = false
263: 				m.Operation = nil
264: 				m.Events = nil
265: 			} else if m.Confirmation != nil {
266: 				m.Confirmation = nil
267: 			} else if m.Operation != nil && !m.OperationHidden {
268: 				m.Operation = nil
269: 				m.Events = nil
270: 				m.ActiveOperation = app.OperationRequest{}
271: 				m.OperationShowPrevious = false
272: 			} else if m.Validation != nil {
273: 				m.Validation = nil
274: 			} else if m.Preview != nil {
275: 				m.Preview = nil
276: 				m.PreviewOffset = 0
277: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent && len(m.Routes) > 1 {
278: 				m.Routes = m.Routes[:len(m.Routes)-1]
279: 				m.Selected = 0
280: 			}
281: 		case ActionUp:
282: 			if m.Preview != nil {
283: 				m.PreviewOffset--
284: 				if m.PreviewOffset < 0 {
285: 					m.PreviewOffset = 0
286: 				}
287: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent && m.Selected > 0 {
288: 				m.Selected--
289: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent && m.Selected == 0 {
290: 				m.Focus = FocusTabs
291: 			}
292: 		case ActionDown:
293: 			if m.Preview != nil {
294: 				m.PreviewOffset++
295: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
296: 				m.Focus = FocusContent
297: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent {
298: 				m.Selected++
299: 				m.clampSelection()
300: 			}
301: 		case ActionLeft:
302: 			if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
303: 				if m.ActiveTab == TabRuns {
304: 					m.setTab(TabStudies)
305: 				} else {
306: 					m.setTab(TabProjects)
307: 				}
308: 				m.Focus = FocusTabs
309: 			}
310: 		case ActionRight:
311: 			if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
312: 				if m.ActiveTab == TabProjects {
313: 					m.setTab(TabStudies)
314: 					m.Focus = FocusTabs
315: 				} else {
316: 					m.Focus = FocusContent
317: 				}
318: 			}
319: 		case ActionProjects:
320: 			m.setTab(TabProjects)
321: 		case ActionStudies:
322: 			m.setTab(TabStudies)
323: 		case ActionRuns:
324: 			m.setTab(TabRuns)
325: 		case ActionOpen:
326: 			if m.Preview != nil {
327: 				return m
328: 			}
329: 			if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
330: 				m.Focus = FocusContent
331: 				return m
332: 			}
333: 			if item, ok := m.selectedItem(); ok && item.Route != nil {
334: 				m.Routes = append(m.Routes, *item.Route)
335: 				m.Selected = 0
336: 			}
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	return m
340: }

342: func dedupeDurableEvents(events []app.RunEvent) []app.RunEvent {
343: 	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(events))
344: 	result := make([]app.RunEvent, 0, min(len(events), 200))
345: 	for _, event := range events {
346: 		key := string(event.RunID) + ":" + fmt.Sprint(event.Sequence)
347: 		if seen[key] {
348: 			continue
349: 		}
350: 		seen[key] = true
351: 		result = append(result, event)
352: 	}
353: 	if len(result) > 200 {
354: 		result = result[len(result)-200:]
355: 	}
356: 	return result
357: }

345: func appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx context.Context, repository runcontrol.Repository, fence runcontrol.Fence, draft runcontrol.EventDraft) (runcontrol.Event, runcontrol.Snapshot, error) {

347: 	for {
348: 		event, snapshot, err := repository.Append(ctx, fence, draft)
349: 		if err == nil || !retryableRunControlError(err) || !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
350: 			return event, snapshot, err
351: 		}
352: 		if err := waitRunControlRetry(ctx, deadline); err != nil {
353: 			return runcontrol.Event{}, runcontrol.Snapshot{}, err
354: 		}
355: 	}

358: func proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx context.Context, repository runcontrol.Repository, fence runcontrol.Fence, proposal runcontrol.TerminalProposal) (runcontrol.Snapshot, bool, error) {
359: 	for {

362: 			return snapshot, won, err
363: 		}
364: 		if err := waitRunControlRetry(ctx, time.Now().Add(250*time.Millisecond)); err != nil {

417: func runtimeEventDraft(req runtimepkg.Request, event runtimepkg.Event) runcontrol.EventDraft {
418: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
419: 	lowerType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Type))
420: 	lowerKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Kind))
421: 	switch lowerType {
422: 	case "warning", "warn", "error":
423: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
424: 	case "artifact", "file":
425: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventArtifact
426: 	case "finding":
427: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventFinding
428: 	case "message", "text", "output", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text", "reasoning", "content", "delta":
429: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
430: 	default:
431: 		// Kind-based fallback: reasoning and message kinds should be visible as message, not coalesced progress.
432: 		switch lowerKind {
433: 		case "message", "reasoning", "assistant", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text":
434: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
435: 		case "tool", "tool_use", "tool_call", "tool_call_update":
436: 			// Tools stay as progress but with distinct payload so coalescing can distinguish.
437: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventProgress
438: 		}
439: 	}
440: 	payload := map[string]string{
441: 		"runtime_event_id": boundedSafe(event.ID),
442: 		"runtime_run_id":   boundedSafe(event.RunID),
443: 		"session_id":       boundedSafe(event.SessionID),
444: 		"type":             boundedSafe(event.Type),
445: 		"kind":             boundedSafe(event.Kind),
446: 	}
447: 	if lowerKind == "tool" || lowerKind == "tool_use" || lowerKind == "tool_call" || lowerKind == "tool_call_update" {
448: 		captureToolObservation(payload, event.Payload)
449: 	}
450: 	// Preserve safe observable payload fields into durable storage for observability.
451: 	// Deny sensitive keys and truncate values to runcontrol-safe limits.
452: 	// Flatten one level of nesting so tool/action names buried in maps are surfaced as top-level payload keys
453: 	// that the run timeline JS expects (payload.tool, payload.action, payload.title, etc.).
454: 	for key, value := range event.Payload {
455: 		if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
456: 			continue
457: 		}
458: 		normalized := strings.TrimSpace(key)
459: 		if normalized == "" || len(normalized) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(normalized, "\x00\r\n") {
460: 			continue
461: 		}
462: 		if normalized == "type" || normalized == "kind" {
463: 			continue
464: 		}
465: 		if nested, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
466: 			for subKey, subVal := range nested {
467: 				if isSensitivePayloadKey(subKey) {
468: 					continue
469: 				}
470: 				subNorm := strings.TrimSpace(subKey)
471: 				if subNorm == "" || len(subNorm) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(subNorm, "\x00\r\n") {
472: 					continue
473: 				}
474: 				if _, exists := payload[subNorm]; exists {
475: 					continue
476: 				}
477: 				// Promote common observable sub-keys; namespace the rest to avoid collisions.
478: 				promote := map[string]bool{"tool": true, "title": true, "detail": true, "text": true, "delta": true, "content": true, "message": true, "action": true, "state": true, "status": true, "native_type": true, "line": true}
479: 				targetKey := subNorm
480: 				if !promote[subNorm] {
481: 					targetKey = normalized + "_" + subNorm
482: 					if len(targetKey) > 128 {
483: 						continue
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				if _, exists := payload[targetKey]; exists {
487: 					continue
488: 				}
489: 				str := payloadValueString(subVal)
490: 				if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
491: 					continue
492: 				}
493: 				if len(payload) >= 30 {
494: 					break
495: 				}
496: 				payload[targetKey] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
497: 			}
498: 			// Also keep a compact stringified top-level for debugging if not promoted.
499: 			if len(payload) < 30 {
500: 				if _, exists := payload[normalized]; !exists {
501: 					str := payloadValueString(value)
502: 					if strings.TrimSpace(str) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(str, "[map omitted") {
503: 						payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
504: 					}
505: 				}
506: 			}
507: 			continue
508: 		}
509: 		str := payloadValueString(value)
510: 		if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
511: 			continue
512: 		}
513: 		if len(payload) >= 30 {
514: 			break
515: 		}
516: 		if _, exists := payload[normalized]; exists {
517: 			continue
518: 		}
519: 		payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
520: 	}
521: 	// Ensure the most useful display keys are always present even if nested.
522: 	for _, want := range []string{"tool", "action", "title", "detail", "text", "delta"} {
523: 		if _, ok := payload[want]; ok {
524: 			continue
525: 		}
526: 		if v := findNestedString(event.Payload, want); v != "" {
527: 			payload[want] = boundedPayloadValue(v)
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	omission := (*runcontrol.Omission)(nil)
531: 	if event.RawPresent || event.RawOmitted {
532: 		reason := firstSafeValue(event.RawOmissionReason, "runtime payload omitted by safe persistence policy")
533: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe(reason), Count: 1}
534: 	} else if len(event.Payload) > len(payload)-5 {
535: 		// Payload had more fields than we persisted (truncated/omitted keys) – record for diagnostics but don't hide persisted fields.
536: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe("runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields"), Count: 1}
537: 	}
538: 	return runcontrol.EventDraft{
539: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeRuntime,
540: 		Stage: boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]), Task: boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"])),
541: 		Kind: payload["kind"], Tool: payload["tool"], Action: payload["action"],
542: 		Reason: payload["reason"], Detail: firstSafeValue(payload["detail"], payload["title"]),
543: 		Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
544: 	}
545: }

624: func captureToolObservation(out map[string]string, payload map[string]any) {
625: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
626: 		"tool_call_id": {"tool_call_id", "toolCallId", "call_id", "callID"},
627: 		"tool_name":    {"tool_name", "toolName", "tool", "name"},

638: 		"tool_result":    {"tool_result", "result", "output", "content"},
639: 		"tool_error":     {"tool_error", "error"},

655: func findNestedPayloadValue(value any, aliases []string, depth int) any {

657: 		return nil
658: 	}
659: 	switch typed := value.(type) {
660: 	case map[string]any:
661: 		for _, key := range aliases {
662: 			if found, ok := typed[key]; ok && found != nil {
663: 				return found
664: 			}
665: 		}
666: 		keys := make([]string, 0, len(typed))
667: 		for key := range typed {
668: 			keys = append(keys, key)

674: 			}

702: 		}
703: 		return redacted
704: 	case string:
705: 		lower := strings.ToLower(typed)
706: 		for _, marker := range []string{"bearer ", "sk-", "ghp_", "github_pat_", "-----begin private key"} {
707: 			if strings.Contains(lower, marker) {

709: 			}

37: func (s *runControlState) repository(ctx context.Context, workspaceRoot string, policies ...runcontrol.RetentionPolicy) (*runcontrol.SQLiteRepository, error) {
38: 	if s == nil {
39: 		return nil, errors.New("run-control process state is unavailable")
40: 	}
41: 	s.mu.Lock()
42: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
43: 	if s.initErr != nil {
44: 		return nil, s.initErr
45: 	}
46: 	if repository := s.repos[workspaceRoot]; repository != nil {
47: 		if len(policies) > 0 && s.policies[workspaceRoot] != policies[0] {
48: 			return nil, errors.New("run-control retention policy changed during the process lifetime")
49: 		}
50: 		return repository, nil
51: 	}
52: 	var retention runcontrol.RetentionPolicy
53: 	if len(policies) > 0 {
54: 		retention = policies[0]
55: 	}
56: 	repository, err := runcontrol.OpenSQLite(ctx, workspaceRoot, runcontrol.SQLiteOptions{Retention: retention})
57: 	if err != nil {
58: 		return nil, err
59: 	}
60: 	logger, err := runcontrol.OpenLocalFileLogger(workspaceRoot)
61: 	if err != nil {
62: 		_ = repository.Close()
63: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open run-control diagnostic log: %w", err)
64: 	}
65: 	repository.SetLogger(logger)
66: 	if _, err := repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
67: 		_ = repository.Close()
68: 		_ = logger.Close()
69: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("startup run reconciliation failed: %w", err)
70: 	}
71: 	s.repos[workspaceRoot] = repository
72: 	s.loggers[workspaceRoot] = logger
73: 	s.policies[workspaceRoot] = retention
74: 	return repository, nil
75: }

77: func (s *runControlState) Close() {
78: 	if s == nil {
79: 		return
80: 	}
81: 	s.mu.Lock()
82: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
83: 	for root, repository := range s.repos {
84: 		_ = repository.Close()
85: 		if logger := s.loggers[root]; logger != nil {
86: 			_ = logger.Close()
87: 			delete(s.loggers, root)
88: 		}
89: 		delete(s.repos, root)
90: 	}
91: }
